proofs.text: Run `add` against a published anchor; verify the pin returned equals `git rev-parse HEAD` in the source, that it is 40 characters long, and that the text above `## Rules` in the copy contains no occurrence of `main`

rule_text: The pin `add` writes is the source's head commit as a full 40-character sha, and no branch name reaches the copy

tests.body:
def test_add_pins_a_commit_not_a_branch(workspace):
    result = _add(workspace)
    head = _git(['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], workspace.anchor_work)
    assert result['pinned'] == head
    assert len(result['pinned']) == 40
    assert 'main' not in _copy_text(workspace).split('## Rules')[0]
tests.name: test_add_pins_a_commit_not_a_branch
